ui.agent_chat_approval: Allow the agent to do this?
ui.agent_chat_attach_view_tip: Send a picture of the current view with the message
ui.agent_chat_auth_env: Set {vars} in your environment and restart SolidCraft.
ui.agent_chat_auth_needed: The agent asks you to sign in. You sign in with the agent itself; SolidCraft never sees your password or keys.
ui.agent_chat_auth_none: The agent offers no sign-in method here: sign in the way its own documentation describes.
ui.agent_chat_auth_terminal: Run this in a terminal, then press Connect again:
ui.agent_chat_custom_hint: Any program that speaks the Agent Client Protocol on stdin and stdout. No shell runs it.
ui.agent_chat_desktop_only: The agent chat needs the desktop app.
ui.agent_chat_intro: Chat with a coding agent you already use, or a model endpoint you choose. It works on the open design through SolidCraft's tools: its changes show as it makes them and undo as one step per message. What it may do without asking is set in Preferences > AI.
ui.agent_chat_limit: The agent reached the limit of {limit} changes for one message. Send another message to let it go on.
ui.agent_chat_model_tip: The model the agent uses. Your choice is remembered for this agent.
ui.agent_chat_new_confirm: Start a new chat? The current one is cleared.
ui.agent_chat_no_cli: solidcraft-cli was not found next to the app, so the agent can't reach the design.
ui.agent_chat_no_control: The agent chat's endpoint did not start, so the agent can't reach the design.
ui.agent_chat_none_found: No coding agent found. Install one of these, then press Refresh:
ui.agent_chat_placeholder: Ask the agent to change the design…
ui.agent_chat_placeholder_busy: Queue a message for when the agent is done (Ctrl+Enter: send now)
ui.agent_chat_privacy: Nothing goes anywhere except to the agent you run, under your own account.
ui.agent_chat_privacy_note: SolidCraft sends nothing anywhere: the agent you run talks to its own service under your own account. SolidCraft never sees or stores a key or password.
ui.agent_chat_queue_full: Too many messages are waiting: remove one or wait for the agent.
ui.agent_chat_send_now_tip: Stop the agent's current step and send this next (Ctrl+Enter)
ui.agent_chat_stop_tip: Stop the agent and everything it started
ui.agent_chat_stop_turn_tip: Stop the agent (Esc). Queued messages stay queued.
ui.ai_add_installed_note: An entry of your own for an installed agent, for example with other arguments. Installed agents are listed by themselves.
ui.ai_agent_mode_tip: The agent's own mode: its own tools (shell, file edits) follow it. SolidCraft's tools follow the permissions in Preferences > AI.
ui.ai_always_allow_tip: Allow {tool} for this agent from now on, without asking
ui.ai_always_allowed_none: Nothing is always allowed yet. "Always allow" answers you give in the chat are listed here.
ui.ai_auto_ours: SolidCraft checks its own tools itself
ui.ai_bad_url: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://
ui.ai_http_busy: the endpoint is busy or over its limit; try again later
ui.ai_http_key: the endpoint refused the key: check it in Preferences > AI
ui.ai_http_not_found: no such endpoint or model: check the base URL and the model name
ui.ai_key_hint: optional; kept in the system keychain
ui.ai_key_needs_https: A key is only sent over HTTPS, or to this computer.
ui.ai_key_note: Stored in the system keychain, never in SolidCraft's settings. Leave it empty for a local server.
ui.ai_mode_all_note: Nothing asks first. Crash reports stay off limits and the folder limits still apply.
ui.ai_mode_all_warning: The agent can save, overwrite, export and replace your design without asking. Use this only with an agent you trust, on designs you have saved.
ui.ai_mode_ask_note: Every change to the design, and every file action, waits for your Allow.
ui.ai_mode_edits_note: Modelling commands run without asking; saving, opening, exporting and other file or destructive actions still ask.
ui.ai_modes_scope: These settings cover SolidCraft's tools. An agent's own tools (its shell, its file edits) follow the agent's own mode, which you pick in the chat panel's header when the agent has modes.
ui.ai_need_command: Enter the command that starts the agent
ui.ai_no_answer: The agent did not answer in time
ui.ai_no_http: This build can't reach API endpoints
ui.ai_no_keychain: The system keychain isn't available, so a key can't be stored. A local server without a key still works.
ui.ai_request_limit: stopped after 24 requests for one message; send another message to go on
ui.ai_show_features_note: The agent chat: a panel where a coding agent you already use, or a model endpoint you choose, works on the open design. Off: no AI button, shortcut, menu entry or panel, and nothing is looked for or started.
ui.ai_switch_tip: Change the agent for this conversation
ui.ai_test_acp_tip: Starts the agent briefly and asks it for a session; ends it again
ui.ai_test_api_tip: Asks the endpoint for its models
ui.ai_tool_unfold: Click to show what it returned
ui.ai_toolbar_button_note: The AI button at the right end of the toolbar. Ctrl+Shift+A and the View menu still open the panel.
ui.ai_undo_tip: Undo everything the agent changed for this message, as one step
